text.description_html:
Omnia 4019/400-US32D 12" Stainless Steel Offset Door Pull

This brushed stainless steel offset door pull has 12" Center to Center mounting points with a total length of 13-1/4". It is most often used on commercial doors such as restaurant doors, store entry doors, and office entry doors. It comes with a Brushed Stainless Steel finish for a truly modern look. Made out of high quality stainless steel, this Omnia made door handle will be sure to turn heads for many years to come.

Also available: 8" Stainless Offset Door Pull and 16" Stainless Offset Door Pull

Specifications for the Omnia 4019/400-US32D Offset Door Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Mounting Centers: 12" (400 mm)
  • Total Length: 13-1/4"
  • Projection: 2-15/16"
  • Pull Diameter: 1"
  • Omnia Pull Back to Back Mounting Instructions (PDF)

When Selecting a Mounting Hardware:

  • Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.
  • Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Requires 2 pulls.

Sold individually (1 door pull handle). If you order Back-to-Back Mounting please Order 2 Pulls.



***THIS ITEM IS DISCONTINUED, LIMITED STOCK AVAILABLE***
